title: revert(kitty-run): roll back to the pre-Momo pastel build
Pass 37: delegated tone-down pass applied - clouds tinted under bloom, star glow tamed, echo single-composited
summary: Chat-model brief (one deliverable, three fixes) applied and verified. Clouds: PALETTE.cloud #ffffff -> #c4d9eb, cloudTexture now routes fill+shadow through it (blur 26->14, alpha 0.96->0.93) - the tint sits below the bloom threshold (sRGB Rec.709 ~0.835 < 0.85) but above skyTop (~0.80), so clouds read as soft lit puffs with no halo and the sun stays the only glowing sky element. Stars: PALETTE.starGlow #fff3b0 -> #f0b429 + star glow scale 3.6 -> 2.2 in Pickups (hearts/heal byte-identical); key physics: additive glow over the bright sky clips toward white regardless of hue, so the magnitude had to drop, not just the colour. Echo rewritten as single-composite (fixes the ghost torso-line-through-head the owner reported; the PLAYER rig was verified clean - the artifact was always the echo): rig stays opaque (retint maps colours only), moves to layer 1 hidden from the main camera, is captured each frame into an sRGB WebGLRenderTarget (clear alpha forced to 0 and restored around the pass), and ONE camera-oriented quad at ECHO_OPACITY x proximity blits the capture 1:1; pinPainterOrder deleted - the RT depth buffer resolves interior occlusion, and no per-part alpha means no stacking anywhere. INTEGRATOR FIX on the submission: its quad placement assumed an axis-aligned camera, but the scene camera yaws ~11 deg toward the run-ahead side and its fov animates, so the z-perpendicular fullscreen plane would have keystone-shifted the echo ~3 world units; replaced with view-axis placement (cam.position + getWorldDirection*dist, camera quaternion, holder-local) - exact at any camera pose, confirmed by the echo landing at the same screen position as pre-refactor. Verified: tsc + vite build green; kitty-run.check.ts 50/50; kitty-run.sim.ts 16/16; headless Chrome probes (domcontentloaded variant) desktop 1440x810 + mobile 390x844 dpr2 + ?plain + autopilot + menu: clouds soft blue-grey with no halo and distinct from the sun (including a cloud crossing the sun), stars small warm halos with the gold star clearly readable, echo head solid in run/jump/dash incl. the dash FOV punch, echo/player depth occlusion intact, player rig unchanged, zero console errors/pageerrors. Uncommitted per policy. Tuning surface if the owner wants more/less: PALETTE.cloud, PALETTE.starGlow, the 2.2 star glow scale in Pickups.tsx, ECHO_OPACITY in Echo.tsx.
